sentences.text: Libya is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa , bordered by the Mediterranean Sea to the north , Egypt to the east , Sudan to the southeast , Chad and Niger to the south and Algeria and Tunisia to the west .	Maghreb	Maghreb	North Africa	North Africa	Mediterranean Sea	Mediterranean Sea	Egypt	Egypt	Sudan	Sudan	Chad	Chad	Niger	Niger	Algeria	Algeria	Tunisia	Tunisia
The country is made of three historical regions , Tripolitania , Fezzan and Cyrenaica .	Tripolitania	Tripolitania	Fezzan	Fezzan	Cyrenaica	Cyrenaica

With an area of almost 1.8 e6km2 , Libya is the fourth largest country in Africa , and is the 16th largest country in the world .	largest country in the world	List of countries and outlying territories by total area
Libya has the 10th-largest proven oil reserves of any country in the world .	proven oil reserves	Proven reserves
The largest city and capital , Tripoli , is located in western Libya and contains over one million of Libya 's six million people .	Tripoli	Tripoli
The other large city is Benghazi , which is located in eastern Libya .	Benghazi	Benghazi
Libya has been inhabited by Berbers since the late Bronze Age .	Berbers	Berber people	Bronze Age	Bronze Age
The Phoenicians established trading posts in western Libya , and ancient Greek colonists established city-states in eastern Libya .

Libya was variously ruled by Carthaginians , Persians , Egyptians and Greeks before becoming a part of the Roman Empire .	Carthaginians	Ancient Carthage	Greeks	Ptolemaic Kingdom	Roman Empire	Roman Empire
Libya was an early centre of Christianity .

After the fall of the Western Roman Empire , the area of Libya was mostly occupied by the Vandals until the 7th century , when invasions brought Islam and Arab colonisation .	Islam	Islam	Roman Empire	Roman Empire	fall of the Western Roman Empire	fall of the Western Roman Empire	Vandals	Vandalic Kingdom	invasions	Muslim conquest of the Maghreb	Arab	Arabs

In the 16th century , the Spanish Empire and the Knights of St John occupied Tripoli , until Ottoman rule began in 1551 .	Tripoli	Tripoli	Spanish Empire	Spanish Empire	Knights of St John	Knights of St John	Ottoman	Ottoman Empire	began in 1551	Ottoman Tripolitania
Libya was involved in the Barbary Wars of the 18th and 19th centuries .	Barbary Wars	Barbary Wars
Ottoman rule continued until the Italian occupation of Libya resulted in the temporary Italian Libya colony from 1911 to 1943 .	Ottoman	Ottoman Empire	Italian Libya	Italian Libya
During the Second World War Libya was an important area of warfare in the North African Campaign .	Second World War	Second World War	North African Campaign	North African Campaign
The Italian population then went into decline .
Libya became independent as a kingdom in 1951 .	kingdom in 1951	Kingdom of Libya
A military coup in 1969 overthrew King Idris I , beginning a period of sweeping social reform .	military coup in 1969	1969 Libyan coup d'état	King Idris I	Idris of Libya

The most prominent coup figure , Muammar Gaddafi , was ultimately able to have power fully concentrated in his hands during the Libyan Cultural Revolution , remaining in power until the Libyan Civil War of 2011 , fought by those supporting the government and by forces attempting to overthrow it , in which the rebels were supported by NATO .	Libyan	Demographics of Libya	Muammar Gaddafi	Muammar Gaddafi	Libyan Cultural Revolution	Libyan Cultural Revolution	Libyan Civil War of 2011	Libyan Civil War (2011)	NATO	NATO
Since then , Libya has experienced a period of instability .

The European Union is involved in an operation intended to disrupt human trafficking networks exploiting refugees fleeing from wars in Africa for Europe .	European Union	European Union	human trafficking	human trafficking
As part of the ongoing second Libyan Civil War -LRB- 2014 -- present -RRB- , at least two political bodies claim to be the government of Libya .	Libyan	Demographics of Libya

The Council of Deputies is one such government , but it does not hold territory in the capital , Tripoli , instead meeting in the Cyrenaica city of Tobruk .	Tripoli	Tripoli	Cyrenaica	Cyrenaica	Council of Deputies	Council of Deputies	Tobruk	Tobruk

Meanwhile , the UN-backed 2014 General National Congress purports to be the legal continuation of the General National Congress , elected in the 2012 Libyan General National Congress election and dissolved following the June 2014 elections but then reconvened by a minority of its members .	Libyan	Demographics of Libya	UN	United Nations	2014 General National Congress	General National Congress (2014)	General National Congress	General National Congress	2012 Libyan General National Congress election	Libyan General National Congress election, 2012

The Supreme Court in the Libya Dawn and General National Congress-controlled Tripoli declared the Tobruk government unconstitutional in November 2014 , but the body has rejected the ruling as made under threat of violence .	Tripoli	Tripoli	Tobruk	Tobruk	General National Congress	General National Congress
Parts of Libya are outside of either government 's control , with various Islamist , rebel , and tribal militias administering some cities and areas .	Islamist	Islamism
The United Nations is sponsoring peace talks between the Tobruk - and Tripoli-based factions .	Tripoli	Tripoli	Tobruk	Tobruk	United Nations	United Nations
An agreement to form a unified interim government was signed on 17 December 2015 .

Under the terms of the agreement , a nine-member Presidency Council and a seventeen-member interim Government of National Accord would be formed , with a view to holding new elections within two years .	Government of National Accord	Government of National Accord

The leaders of the new government , called the Government of National Accord -LRB- GNA -RRB- , arrived in Tripoli on 5 April 2016 .	Tripoli	Tripoli	Government of National Accord	Government of National Accord
Since then the GNC , one of the two rival governments , has disbanded to support the new GNA .
